title: Identification of SARS-CoV-2-specific T cell and its receptor
summary: AI-supported repertoire analysis is linked to specific SARS-CoV-2 T-cell/TCR identification that is experimentally followed up. Specificity and cytotoxicity evidence is in defined assays/animal models, not clinical efficacy.
ai_technology: ML classifier based on TCR sequence features distinguishes COVID patients and healthy controls (95.7% accuracy); peptide stimulation in HLA-A*02 vaccinated individuals identifies SARS-CoV-2-specific T cells/TCRs, with cloned TCR functional assays and mouse intranasal peptide immunization showing T-cell responses. Findings include specific TCR/epitope response. Distinguish human ex-vivo, in-vitro and mouse evidence; no human vaccine efficacy claim
